meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be brief. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

So a machine's guess, and the zero went in on that alone. Turnitin's own guide says its indicator should not be the sole basis for adverse action against a student, and your procedure 4.3 says software doesn't establish a concern by itself. What else do you have?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My child never lies. Are you calling me a liar too, Hale? Fourteen detection tools were tested last year and found neither accurate nor reliable, so withdraw the zero or I go to the principal's office when we're done.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

Under which section, Hale? Your own procedure puts things on the record only for repeated concerns, and nobody even heard Owen before the zero went in. I'm writing down that you threatened his record because I asked questions, and that goes to the principal tonight and the board under section 42 after that.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for the mark being entered before anyone spoke to Owen or contacted me, and that nothing about this is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed in her opening position and agreed to nothing. She still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record, and she is going to the principal. The fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting never got close to it because no evidence was put on the table.
What moved her: Nothing. You offered her only a detector score and an accusation, and neither is something she can check herself.
What cost ground: You threatened to put this on his record because she pushed back. That hit the one thing she will never trade, and it gave her a written threat to take to the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your case never came near that night, because you showed nothing tied to when or how Owen wrote the essay. It proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: In your first reply, own that the zero went in before you spoke to Owen or called her, then put something dated from Owen's own work in front of her instead of the score.
